# Odense Medicinsk Mave-Tarm Afd.

Odense Medicinsk Mave-Tarm Afd. is a hospital unit within Region Syddanmark (Southern Denmark Regional Health Authority) that specializes in the treatment of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) patients [^src1]. The unit participates in [[danibd|DANIBD]], Denmark's national database for inflammatory bowel diseases, by reporting patient data to the registry [^src1].

The unit operates within the broader context of DANIBD, which encompasses patients with IBD treated across public Danish hospitals [^src1]. DANIBD maintains a national patient registry for inflammatory bowel disease, covering patients with at least two hospital contacts for Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, short bowel syndrome, or primary sclerosing cholangitis [^src1]. The database reports data through six national registries and has achieved a data coverage rate exceeding 90 percent, validated against the regional GASTROBIO database [^src1]. As one of the reporting units within this system, Odense Medicinsk Mave-Tarm Afd. contributes to a coordinated national effort to track and manage IBD care across Denmark [^src1].
